query:
INSERT INTO employees (first_name, 
                                    last_name, 
                                    job_title, 
                                    division_id, 
                                    employment_type, 
                                    location_id, 
                                    manager_unid, 
                                    email,
                                    password)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
            RETURNING unid AS employee_unid, 
                        first_name, 
                        last_name, 
                        job_title, 
                        division_id, 
                        employment_type AS "employment_type!: EmploymentType", 
                        location_id, 
                        manager_unid, 
                        email
